description.value: The Best Western Maple Ridge Hotel is a full-service chain hotel on the Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, sitting minutes from Golden Ears Provincial Park and Whonnock Lake — two major outdoor destinations in the Fraser Valley. The property is pet-friendly and offers rooms with kitchenette options, making it a practical base for cyclists on multi-day touring routes through the Lower Mainland. Its position along the Lougheed corridor puts it close to the mountain gateways northeast of Vancouver.
